newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FINLAND BACKS HUNGARY'S EU ACCESS IN EQUAL RACE.
newsitem.headline: FINLAND BACKS HUNGARY'S EU ACCESS IN EQUAL RACE.

text.p: Finland will continue to support Hungary's European Union (EU) membership bid but insists that talks should begin simultaneously with all EU hopefuls, the Finnish foreign minister said on Tuesday.

"Hungary will start the race on equal terms, and it is up to them to build up an advantage," Finnish Foreign Minister Tarja Halonen told a news conference after meeting his Hungarian counterpart, Laszlo Kovacs.
Hungary, while disappointed by the turn of events, accepts the new situation and will try to make the best of it, Kovacs said.

"We thought that negotiations would have been quicker with a smaller number of countries involved ...but we have accepted the fact the EU inclines to start negotiations with all 12 countries at the same time," Kovacs said.
He added, that Hungary would belong to the group of countries with which the talks would proceed faster.
"Our original idea to be among the first to join the EU could also come true this way," he said.
